chapter_01.prompt:
GLOBAL STYLE: Warm, whimsical feature-film 3D animation inspired by Up, retaining the supplied puppy designs. 16:9. Rounded forms, expressive eyes, soft detailed fur, warm honey light and teal foliage.
SCENE: Meet Tart and Tine; a gentle game begins. @Tart and @Tine in @garden.
LOCATION: Fixed enclosed training garden; gravel path, low wooden bridge over a dry bed, daisies at far ramp and oak beyond.
FIRST FRAME AND BLOCKING: Tart sits left, Tine right, blue ball between them on the near side of the bridge.
SHOT-BY-SHOT BREAKDOWN:
Shot 1 (0s-3s): @Tart and @Tine sit together in @garden, ears perked. @Tart glances shyly at @Tine; @Tine answers with a bright tail wag. Camera: 35mm wide at puppy eye height; slow push toward both puppies. Audio: Soft breeze, distant birds; original playful piano motif begins. End state: Tart looks toward the ball; Tine lifts one forepaw. Hard cut.
Shot 2 (3s-6s): @Tine lowers a forepaw onto @ball and gently nudges it along the gravel path; @Tart tilts the head in delight. Camera: 50mm medium two-shot; paws and faces in one coherent composition. Audio: Soft rubber tap and gravel tick; pizzicato joins piano. End state: The ball starts rolling east, screen-left to screen-right. Hard cut.
Shot 3 (6s-10s): @Tart and @Tine trot after @ball through @garden toward the near bridge ramp. @Tine leads by half a body length. Camera: 35mm lateral tracking, consistent left-to-right travel. Audio: Light paw patter; vest cloth flutter; upbeat motif. End state: Ball reaches the near bridge ramp; both dogs are approaching behind it.
OPTICS and CAMERA: Puppy eye height. Use the stated 35mm, 50mm, 65mm or 85mm-equivalent lenses; gentle dolly movement, readable actions and moderate depth of field.
PHYSICS: Four anatomically consistent paws per puppy, natural canine locomotion; ear and vest secondary motion; the rubber ball rolls with friction and slows on grass. Bridge is low and stable; a harmless creak does not signify structural failure.
LIGHTING: Same late-afternoon sun from upper screen-left throughout, soft skylight, bounced gold light, no change of weather or time.
AUDIO: No spoken dialogue, narration or subtitles. The shot-level Foley and ambience remain audible. Use an original gentle piano/pizzicato score, never a film soundtrack.
CONTINUITY LOCKS: @Tart is beige; @Tine is caramel brown with a pale heart on the right rear haunch. Preserve their reference faces, orange gray-trimmed training vests and blue circular patches. Reference sheets show multiple views of only one dog each. Two dogs total. Normal travel is left to right; Tine's motivated return is right to left. Ball never changes color, size, stripe, ownership or location without a visible action. Keep the bridge ramps, daisies and oak fixed. No duplicate dogs, morphing, floating paws, extra limbs, watermarks or on-screen text.
